text:
Hi there, and thanks so much for contacting Leafy! 🌿

I'm sorry to say that live plants can't be returned for a change of mind, so if the plant simply isn't to your taste, we can't take it back. I know that's disappointing, especially when you were excited about it.

There are a couple of situations where we *can* help, though:

- **Plant Care Guarantee:** If your plant dies or declines significantly (losing more than a third of its leaves, stem or root rot, or collapse) despite reasonable care, we'll send one free replacement. You can claim from "My Orders" within **30 days** of delivery (**90 days** for Leafy Plus members) with at least two photos: one of the whole plant and one close-up. A Plant Care Specialist will review it within **2 business days**.
- **Damaged on Arrival:** If it arrived with snapped main stems, a cracked or smashed pot, exposed roots, or was dead or severely wilted, please report it within **48 hours** of delivery with photos of the plant and the box. We'll send a free replacement or a refund.

A few bent leaves or some loose soil is normal after shipping, and yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks is usually just transplant stress. Plants often perk up once they settle in. Keep them out of direct sun for the first week, and water only when the top inch of soil is dry.

If you're worried about how your plant looks, our Plant Care Specialists offer free advice by chat (9am-5pm Mon-Fri) or email. Just tell me what you're seeing and I can point you in the right direction.

Thanks again for reaching out, and please come back any time! 🌱
